title: Parameters, filters and grouping
goal: Design report parameters, filters and grouping without changing total semantics.
prerequisites: onec.p8; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Design report parameters, filters and grouping without changing total semantics.
sections: Filtering rows before aggregation differs from filtering groups after it. “Requests longer than 30 minutes” is not “customers totaling more than 30.” A customer with two short requests distinguishes them. Settings must express the intended requirement.

Define the question and granularity before composition. Customer-minute sums, average document cost and open-request counts need distinct resources/denominators. Similar-looking reports are not interchangeable. Use uneven groups and independent calculations to expose averaging/grouping errors that symmetric toy examples can hide. Check underlying identities before interpreting the final visual representation.

Supply virtual-table period, customer and status with correct types. A dynamic CurrentMonth parameter is convenient operationally but should be fixed for reproducible evidence. Avoid hidden conditions lost on reopening. A saved variant must restore every material value.

Schema describes available data, settings select retrieval/presentation, and output produces a result. Changing one level does not silently authorize changing another. Record parameters, variant, time and units. Saved settings usually are not frozen data snapshots; new documents can legitimately change the same variant. Preserve membership and observed values for reproducibility as well as the configuration of the report.

Customer minute sums remain minutes. For a per-document average, specify numerator and denominator; an average of group averages generally differs from the global average. Use customers with unequal request counts as a control. Apply rounding at the declared point.

External components and exports cross distinct boundaries. Processors execute code and need provenance, authority and environment checks. Printed files present data under edition constraints. In-memory generation is not actual saving or printing. Explain unavailable capabilities honestly; circumventing platform limits is not an acceptable educational workaround. Preserve source records when output fails or cancellation occurs.

Compare rows>30, groups>30, average and sum on one set. Specify expected identities and values beforehand, then save/reopen the variant. A missing-filter negative control must fail. If every variant accidentally yields one number, the dataset does not distinguish wrong implementations and must expand.

Trace each report row to source facts. Verify membership/units, then aggregation/presentation. A deliberately wrong filter in a copy must alter the expected result and be detected. Repeat ordinary, empty and boundary datasets after correction. This demonstrates test sensitivity rather than merely generating a plausible screen once without a runtime error.
